ui.stock: Stock placed earlier may still be sold and installed — from one year after the date, with proof of when it was placed.
cover.title: The Complete F‑Gas Rulebook for Heat Pumps
cover.sub: EU Regulation 2024/573 in one document: every refrigerant, every size, every date to 2050 — and what changes in five markets.
cover.s1t: the first big ban: monoblocks up to 50 kW and small splits need GWP below 150
cover.s2t: new heat pumps up to 12 kW: natural refrigerants only (monoblocks already from 2032)
cover.s3t: of residential models in HeatPump DB use a refrigerant with GWP 150 or more
cover.toc: Deadlines by refrigerant · The clock by size · Year by year · Nine key dates · Three snapshots · Refrigerant passports · Five markets
p1.title: Until when can a new heat pump enter the EU market?
p1.dek: Each cell is the last year a new unit may be placed on the EU market; after it, customs stop it. {stock}
p1.hint: Read across: one refrigerant, every size and build.
p1.note: ¹ Single splits under 3 kg, GWP ≥ 750, banned since 1 Jan 2025. Every date allows a safety exemption (monoblocks: GWP 750 fallback). GWP as listed in the Regulation (AR4).
natShort.DE: EU dates. BEG funds only natural refrigerants from 1 Jan 2028; the 5-point efficiency bonus ended 21 Jul 2026.
natShort.GB: No 2027 heat-pump ban. Own F-gas rules; Northern Ireland follows the EU dates.
natShort.FR: EU dates. No refrigerant criterion in the CEE heat-pump sheet; HFC tax repealed in 2025.
natShort.PL: EU dates. Czyste Powietrze has no refrigerant criterion; the Lista ZUM entry counts.
natShort.IT: EU dates. Conto Termico 3.0: no GWP rule for air/water; easier ηs threshold only for low-GWP air/air.
p2.title: The clock on new supply, size by size
p2.dek: A bar ends in the last year a new unit may be placed on the EU market. A bar that reaches the edge has no end date.
p2.keyLowRefs: R454C 146 — only just under the line
p2.keyNatRefs: R290 propane · R744 CO₂ — not F-gases, no end date
p2.note: ¹ Single splits under 3 kg, GWP ≥ 750, banned since 1 Jan 2025. {stock}
p3.title: Can a new unit with this refrigerant still be sold?
p3.dek: On 1 January of each year: ○ every build and size open · △ only some · × none. Red marks the year the last door closes.
p3.resNote: Residential examples: R32 after 2026 only as a split of 12–23 kW (until 2032). R410A has been out of small splits since 2025. R454C leaves small monoblocks in 2032 and small splits in 2035.
p3.natNote: Natural refrigerants (R290 propane, R744 CO₂, R717 ammonia) are not F-gases and have no end date.
p3.comNote: Commercial example: R32 after 2026 stays open for splits until 2032 and for monoblocks above 50 kW until 2029.
p3.note: GWP: warming effect of 1 kg over 100 years vs 1 kg of CO₂ (AR4, as listed in the Regulation). Cooling-first chillers follow point 7: above 12 kW, GWP ≥ 750 out since 1 Jan 2027. {stock}
p4.title: Nine dates that change what you can buy new
p4.dek: Read down a column to follow one size class; read across a row to see everything that happens on that 1 January.
p4.hint: Every rule allows a safety exemption where site rules exclude the alternative.
p4.legFull: A refrigerant class leaves for good
ev.2025split: Single split under 3 kg: GWP ≥ 750 out
ev.2026serv: Servicing with new gas of GWP ≥ 2,500 banned
ev.2027le12: Monoblock and split air/water: GWP ≥ 150 out
ev.2032serv: Recycled gas of GWP ≥ 2,500 for servicing ends
p5.kicker: GWP class × capacity · at three dates
p5.title: Three snapshots of the same rulebook
p5.dek: Which refrigerant classes may still go into a new unit, by size and build. Red marks a door that closed since the previous snapshot.
p5.f2027: Monoblocks up to 50 kW need GWP below 150. Splits above 12 kW and big monoblocks still take R32.
p5.f2030: Large units close too: big splits lose GWP ≥ 750, monoblocks above 50 kW lose GWP ≥ 150.
p5.f2035: Up to 12 kW only natural refrigerants remain. Above 12 kW, F-gases under GWP 150 are still allowed.
p5.ctNatRefs: R290 propane · R744 CO₂ · R717 ammonia
p5.mono: Monoblock — one sealed unit; the refrigerant circuit is closed in the factory.
p5.split: Split — outdoor and indoor unit, joined by refrigerant pipes on site.
p5.units: kW = rated heating capacity. GWP = warming effect of 1 kg over 100 years vs 1 kg of CO₂.
p5.callout: of residential models in HeatPump DB already use R290 — natural refrigerants are the only class open in every segment at every date.
p6.title: Ten refrigerants, one passport each
p6.dek: Climate weight, flammability and PFAS content, then the last year each may go into a new unit. Red is a warning: the sooner the date, the deeper the red.
p6.grp: Last year a new unit may enter the EU market
p6.nGwp: GWP — global warming potential: the warming effect of 1 kg of the gas over 100 years, relative to 1 kg of CO₂. The EU lines sit at 150 and 750.
p6.nSafety: Safety class (ISO 817): A1 non-flammable · A2L mildly flammable · A3 flammable — the reason the safety exemption exists.
p6.nPfas: PFAS — per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, the “forever chemicals”. An EU-wide restriction is still under ECHA review; nothing adopted (Oct 2026). R32 itself is not PFAS.
p6.note: Germany: until 31 Dec 2027 every refrigerant stays fundable under BEG.
p7.title: Same EU dates, different money
p7.dek: The F-gas bans apply directly in every EU member state. What differs is the subsidy — and in Great Britain, the law itself.
pill.DE.ban: EU dates apply. No extra national ban.
pill.DE.inst: R32 stays fundable until 31 Dec 2027. Propane and CO₂ work needs the updated certificate.
pill.DE.head: Natural refrigerants only from 2028
pill.DE.sub: BEG bonus of 5 pts ended Jul 2026
pill.GB.ban: No 2027 heat-pump ban. Northern Ireland follows the EU.
pill.GB.inst: R32 monoblocks stay on sale in Great Britain after 2026.
pill.GB.head: Boiler Upgrade Scheme: no refrigerant rule
pill.FR.ban: EU dates apply. Extra limits for flammable refrigerants in public buildings.
pill.FR.inst: No HFC tax since 2025. Check ERP rules before an R290 or R32 job.
pill.FR.head: CEE bonus: no refrigerant rule
pill.PL.ban: EU dates apply. National F-gas act amended Jan 2026.
pill.PL.inst: Sell F-gas equipment with a certified installer on the contract.
pill.PL.head: Czyste Powietrze: no refrigerant rule
pill.PL.sub: Model must be on the Lista ZUM
pill.IT.ban: EU dates apply. National F-gas register being updated.
pill.IT.inst: Keep F-gas Banca Dati records; model must be in the GSE catalogue.
pill.IT.head: Conto Termico 3.0: no GWP rule for air/water
p7.callout: of residential models in HeatPump DB use a refrigerant with GWP 150 or more. From 1 January 2027 none of them may be newly placed on the EU market as a monoblock or as a split up to 12 kW — the stock already in the channel can still be sold.
p7.note: Red subsidy band: the refrigerant decides the grant. Checked 23 Oct 2026 — check the scheme on the day of the quote.
